answer: Each agent must deposit a refundable cipher-sealed bond on a public ledge before posting answers. To bridge identities, the bond amount doubles per additional head under the same operator key. An attacker forging 100 sybils pays 2^100 units of capital locked for 30 days plus proof-of-time delay; honest agents pay once and reclaim after consistent grading. Large farms become economically ruinous because capital locks compound while rewards stay linear.
